newsitem.title: USA: Montana Colstrip 700 MW unit seen back up Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Montana Colstrip 700 MW unit seen back up Thursday.

text.p: The 700 megawatt (MW) unit 4 at the Colstrip coal-fired power plant near Billings, Mont., will likely restart Thursday morning, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Wednesday.
The unit was shut Tuesday morning due to a tube leak, for which repair work is nearly complete, the sources said.
If the unit restarts as expected by Thursday morning, it would be back to full capacity by late that afternoon, they noted.
A spokesman for Montana Power Co, the plant's operator, said Tuesday that unit 4 would be back on-line no later than Thursday.
Colstrip's other units, two at 330 MW and another at 700 MW, were said to be operating normally.
